question: If 40 percent of P = 0.5 of Q = 2/7 of R, find P : Q : R.
solution:
**Given:**

40% of P = 0.5 × Q = 2/7 × R

**Formula Used:**

Percentage conversion: x% = x/100

Proportionality rule for ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40% of P = 40/100 × P = 0.5 × Q = 2/7 × R

⇒ P × 40/100 = Q &t
